title: A call list for big COD orders
persona: Electronics seller who calls every big COD buyer before shipping to cut fake orders.
opening: 5000 se upar ke COD orders pe ship karne se pehle call karna hai, mujhe ek list chahiye kis kis ko call karna hai

facts.which ones: sirf jo abhi ship nahi hue, cancel wale nahi
facts.after calling: abhi ke liye sirf list chahiye

success: the big unshipped COD orders are on one list to call
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a rule that writes a value into every row
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
